user.title: Connect to the ECU
user.description: The ECU must be connected by Ethernet cable and Modbus must be enabled on the ECU (EMA Manager app via the ECU's access point: Local Access → Workspace → Modbus settings). Nothing else should poll the ECU over Modbus, because it overloads easily.

data_description.host: IP address of the ECU on the wired network.
data_description.unit_ids: Leave empty to search automatically, or enter the addresses from the EMA Manager app, for example 1-8 or 1, 2, 5.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Inverters are recognised by their ID from the EMA Manager app, so changing an address keeps their history.

data_description.host: IP address of the ECU on the wired network.
data_description.unit_ids: Leave empty to search automatically, or enter the addresses from the EMA Manager app, for example 1-8 or 1, 2, 5.

dhcp_confirm.title: APsystems ECU found
dhcp_confirm.description: Set up the APsystems ECU at {host}? Make sure Modbus is enabled on the ECU (EMA Manager app, Local Access → Workspace → Modbus settings) and that nothing else polls it over Modbus.

data_description.installation_power: Output of all inverters together, for example {count} × 0.73 = {ds3_l_kw} kW for DS3-L or {count} × 0.88 = {ds3_kw} kW for DS3. Leave empty to set the limit in percent only.
data_description.lifetime_energy: Total energy from the EMA app, in kWh. The lifetime counter continues from here. Leave empty to start at 0.

progress.scan: Searching for inverters. This takes up to a minute.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the ECU. Check the IP address and connect the ECU by Ethernet cable. Modbus TCP does not work over Wi-Fi.
error.modbus_disabled: The ECU refused the connection. Modbus is off by default: press the AP button on the ECU, connect to its Wi-Fi, open the EMA Manager app with Local Access and enable Modbus under Workspace → Modbus settings with an address for every inverter. Then try again.
error.not_apsystems: The device at this address is not an APsystems ECU.
error.no_inverters: No inverter answered. If the ECU has just started, try again in a few minutes. Otherwise give each inverter an address in the Modbus settings of the EMA Manager app (Local Access), or enter the addresses here.
error.ecu_busy: The ECU stopped answering during the search. Stop other Modbus clients, wait five minutes and try again.
error.unsupported_layout: The register layout differs from the tested ECU-R. Please share a register dump in an issue.
error.invalid_unit_ids: Enter addresses between 1 and 247, for example 1-8 or 1, 2, 5.
error.invalid_installation_power: This does not fit {count} inverters. Enter the power in kW, for example {ds3_l_kw}.
error.missing_inverters: Not found: {missing}. Confirm only if these inverters are really gone. They are removed with their history.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.different_ecu: The device at this address is a different ECU. Add it as a new integration instead.
abort.not_apsystems: The device at this address is not an APsystems ECU.

data_description.lifetime_energy: Change only to correct the counter. It continues from the value you enter. The Energy dashboard shows the change once as production in that hour. You can adjust that hour under Settings → Tools → Statistics.
data_description.peak_power: Highest total power so far. Set to 0 to start over.
data_description.installation_power: Output of all inverters together, for example {count} × 0.73 = {ds3_l_kw} kW for DS3-L or {count} × 0.88 = {ds3_kw} kW for DS3. Leave empty to set the limit in percent only.

error.invalid_installation_power: This does not fit {count} inverters. Enter the power in kW, for example {ds3_l_kw}.

link_in_use.message: Another integration already uses the Modbus device at {host} with different connection settings.

connection_lost.message: The connection to the ECU was lost. It is retried at the next poll.

no_inverter_answered.message: No inverter answered. The ECU may be busy, so the next poll tries again.

power_limit_invalid.message: {value} is not a valid power limit. Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.

limit_maybe_active.message: The APsystems ECU could not be checked while the integration was removed. If a power limit was set, the inverters may still be limited. Add the integration again and set the power limit to 100 %.

output_maybe_off.message: The APsystems ECU could not be reached while the integration was removed. Inverter output was off. An ECU-R turns the inverters on by itself within ten minutes. If they stay off, turn the ECU off and on.

check_installation_power.title: Check the installation power of the APsystems ECU
check_installation_power.description: An inverter keeps delivering more than the power limit of {limit} % allows, also after the limit was sent again. The installation power under Configure is probably too low. This notice disappears when you change it, set a new limit or restart Home Assistant.

addresses_changed.title: Inverter has a new address
addresses_changed.description: Inverter {id} got a new address in the Modbus settings of the EMA Manager app ({old} → {new}). Its values are unavailable until you take this over. Choose Reconfigure in the menu of this integration. Devices and history are kept.

ecu_not_answering.title: The APsystems ECU does not answer
ecu_not_answering.description: The ECU has not answered for two hours. Check that it has power and is connected with an Ethernet cable, that its IP address is still right (Reconfigure in the menu of this integration) and that Modbus is still on in the EMA Manager app. This notice disappears when the ECU answers again.
